name: Numakers PETG-HS @Solder
filament_notes: Numakers PETG-HS 1.75mm, Pitch Black (x2) and Transparent (x1). Temps taken from 25 COMPLETED prints on this machine (Feb 2026, Cura 5.10.2): 250C nozzle / 80C bed / 40% fan / 30% first layer fan. Those were bowden-era with the stock hotend - the all-metal hotend may want a few degrees less. VERIFY against the spool label. Hold 250/245: bringup-log.md warns that PETG under ~245 C in this all-metal hotend skips, and this machine has a clog history, so temperature is the wrong variable to move first against stringing.
filament_start_gcode: SET_PRESSURE_ADVANCE ADVANCE=0.04 ; starting point for direct drive PETG, NOT measured - run a PA tower, see machine/calibration.md
